description: Portable synthetic benchmark. Die maps are base power; workload traffic and placement-dependent rectangular port and route heat are added at evaluation.
coordinate_convention: x right, y up, origin at lower-left interposer corner; map row 0 is the bottom edge of its die
power_unit: Base W per cell, not W/mm^2; each 16x16 map sums to base die watts before interconnect power

thermal_model.boundary_note: Fixed 44 x 34 mm central high-conductance top contact; outside it, TIM has 2 m K/W resistivity. No additional side-edge or bottom convection. Synthetic contact heterogeneity, not a measured cooler.

interconnect_model.assumption: Each endpoint PHY uniformly heats a reserved-length by 2 mm rectangle centered on its die edge, 1 mm inside and 1 mm outside; half of its PHY watts go into die-plane pixels and half into interposer tiles outside the die. Routed wire energy is uniform per route mm including port-to-track access and deposited into the interposer tile layer. Coefficients are synthetic.

mixed_serving.profile: asymmetric mixed compute and memory service
